sample_unit: patients (planned; 300 per trial across two trials)
unlisted_practices: Providing patients an AI-generated layperson-language summary of referral or discharge documents before a consultation, with human verification against the source using a checklist
Independent safety overseer and defined information-related adverse events during an AI trial

screen.reason: This protocol describes two randomized controlled trials testing the deployment of human-verified LLM-generated layperson summaries for patients in real clinical workflows to assess impact on doctor-patient communication and safety.

primary.practice: human verification of AI layperson summaries using predefined checklist
